listing.description: Light-filled and inviting, this two-bedroom, one-bath Montclair cottage offers a level-in entry, single-level living, and an open floor plan with filtered Bay views. The updated kitchen features new appliances, a skylight, and an adjoining laundry room, while the primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet. The living room opens to a level garden, creating an easy flow for entertaining, gathering with friends, watching children play, or enjoying a quiet afternoon outside. Friendly neighbors add to the welcoming feel, and the nearby Railroad Trail connects to the shops, restaurants, and cafés of Montclair Village.

verdict: A move-in-ready 1938 Montclair cottage whose real trade is scale for setting: only 1,192 sqft, 2bd/1ba and neighbors 15 feet away, in exchange for a genuine (tree- and lattice-tower-filtered) Bay Bridge view from the living room, a rare level garden courtyard, abundant skylight-driven natural light, and tasteful period-preserving renovation. The marketing's big panoramas are drone-altitude — the living-level view is a filtered sliver, charming rather than cinematic. Fire zone, overhanging oaks, and the tower+wire eyesore are the real costs; the courtyard, WIC, and Dutch-door character are the real payoff.
